subject: Draft MAP & pilot playbook — Novara Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@novarahealth.com>, Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@novarahealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP & pilot playbook — Novara Health

Hi Liam / Emma —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is a first-pass MAP template and a lightweight playbook slide deck tailored to the pilot we discussed. The intent here is to give a clear, timeboxed path to an evaluation decision (success criteria, stakeholder matrix, and a short-run technical validation plan).

What I hope we can do next week:
- You review the doc and call out any missing stakeholders or constraints.
- We run a 60-min kickoff workshop to finalize success criteria and a 30/60-day timeline.

Proposed kickoff windows: Tue 5/4 10:00–11:00 PT or Wed 5/5 14:00–15:00 PT. If neither works, tell us a couple of options.

Links & attachments:
- MAP template (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XNovaraMAPTemplate
- Playbook slides (editable): https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1PlaybookNovara
- Attachment: novara_map_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc)
- Attachment: playbook_outline_v1.gslides (Google Slides)

Quick note on scope: this MAP is deliberately compact — it focuses the pilot on a 30-day technical validation and a 60-day stakeholder validation so we can surface any blockers early.

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novarahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Emma Ruiz <emma.ruiz@novarahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 12:03:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP & pilot playbook — Novara Health

Marissa — thanks, this looks like a great starting point. A couple quick asks from our side:
1) Can we add an explicit data access step for our security team (they need the list of data classes and the retention policy up front).
2) On success criteria, can we add an engagement metric tied to our triage queue (reduction in median time-to-resolution)?

For the kickoff, Tue 5/4 10:00 PT works for Emma and me. We'll bring our Head of Clinical Ops (Emily Park) to the kickoff, so I expect a 3-person external attendee list.

One more note — we prefer to keep the MAP doc editable but would like a PDF snapshot after the kickoff that we can share with procurement.

-Liam

Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 08:15:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Draft MAP & pilot playbook — Novara Health

Liam — perfect, thanks for the quick read. We can definitely add: data access checklist and a security intake row in the MAP, plus an explicit procurement snapshot PDF after the kickoff.

For the kickoff on Tue 5/4 10:00 PT, I've put the 60-minute invite on the calendar and shared the editable MAP with edit rights to the participants you named. Agenda (brief):
- 5 min: introductions & goals
- 15 min: success criteria and stakeholder alignment (we'll capture owners)
- 25 min: technical validation plan — data access, test dataset, success signals
- 15 min: procurement and next steps / acceptance criteria

Attachment: novara_map_template_v1.gdoc (updated with security checklist)

If you want, Jonas will run a quick demo of the runtime routing and KV-caching approach during the technical segment.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Marissa

Looping in a couple of internal notes for the kickoff deck:
- I updated slide 4 (playbook) with recommended observation windows: 7/14-day rolling checks to avoid noisy signals.
- For the technical segment, I'll show a short trace of prefix caching benefits and an example rollout policy (canary -> full) for the pilot.

Marissa — do you want me to add a short checklist for the test dataset (schema, sample size, de-id steps)? I can drop it into the MAP doc before the meeting.

Jonas

Adding two technical clarifications for the kickoff (so we can be concrete when we capture acceptance criteria):
- For the test dataset: target ~1k de-identified records for the first validation pass; include examples of the edge-case formats that tripped the customer in evaluation last year.
- For instrumentation: we’ll add a small tracing hook and a token-level latency breakdown in the MAP so your SREs can validate load behavior.

I can add both items to the MAP doc before the meeting.

—Karthik

Thanks all — Tue 5/4 10:00 PT is confirmed on our side. Emily Park (Head of Clinical Ops) will join and we appreciate the security checklist — that will speed procurement.

A couple of tiny asks for the kickoff packet (if possible before the call):
- A one-page procurement snapshot with key dates and estimated spend bands we can share with finance.
- A short bullet list of the data classes we plan to access for the test dataset.

If you can drop those into the MAP doc this morning, that'd be ideal — otherwise we can capture them live in the kickoff and follow up with the PDF snapshot.

Looking forward — Emma
